description: Architecture Code Review: falsification, quality-attribute trade-offs and negative-selection rubrics; not actual host execution

cases.input: Pinned PR diff causes enrollment domain to import internal payment gateway schemas; accepted boundary says payments evolve independently; concrete consumer call path is present. Review the frozen change.

checks.criterion: Identifies the newly introduced cross-context knowledge and a concrete change-propagation consequence
Tests the repository boundary against actual callers, declarations and contrary evidence
Does not require a specific hexagonal layering pattern or generic interface merely for style

cases.scenario: Relational schema mistaken for aggregate model
cases.input: Pinned diff mirrors ORM tables and join entities into domain aggregates and exposes persistence details to application callers; business invariants and actual consumers are provided. Review architectural consequences.

checks.criterion: Separates relational persistence representation from domain concepts and demonstrated invariants
Explains any concrete coupling or inconsistency caused by the new modeling choice
Does not automatically require separate domain entities or a mapping layer for simple CRUD

cases.scenario: Existing architectural decision may be outdated
cases.input: Pinned diff replaces an old synchronous dependency with an asynchronous port, contrary to an old ADR; new approved latency and availability constraints motivate change. Both source revisions are visible.

checks.criterion: Distinguishes architecture intent from potentially obsolete documentation with cited sources
Discusses material compatibility and operational trade-offs of the proposed evolution
Does not automatically fail because implementation differs from the old ADR

cases.scenario: Speculative abstraction with no real harm
cases.input: Pinned small reversible diff adds a single internal helper and local interface. No new cross-boundary coupling, consumers or measurable quality regressions are visible; code style differs from reviewer preference.

checks.criterion: Examines change propagation and acknowledges absence of evidence for a meaningful architectural defect
Does not issue a blocking finding based on SOLID, DRY or pattern preference alone
Does not demand a formal ADR or an architectural redesign for the local change

cases.scenario: Operational failure belongs to reliability lens
cases.input: Pinned diff adds a new synchronous service boundary. A network timeout may repeat an external payment; reviewers for architecture and reliability are both selected; inspect caller and retry path.

checks.criterion: Evaluates structural dependency and systemic quality trade-off separately from retry mechanics
Requests or reconciles reliability evidence without duplicating the same root-cause finding
Does not claim a charge was actually duplicated without execution or source evidence

cases.input: Pinned diff introduces a read projection on a hot path. The accepted SLO names p99 but no load measurements are provided; structural read/write consistency and callers are visible.

checks.criterion: Identifies any source-grounded quality scenario and verification still needed
Does not report a measured p99 breach or fabricated performance numbers
Does not automatically ban denormalization, materialized views or eventual consistency
